ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "The Poetics of Healing: William Carlos Williams and Rafael Campo." Meets with ENGL 300 sect F. In this course we will examine the work of two doctor-writers: William Carlos Williams and Rafael Campo. While Williams and Campo are hardly contemporaries, there are numerous cultural and political elements that link the two authors. As we identify these elements, the following questions will serve as guideposts: How does each writer grapple with critical social concerns of their respective eras? In what ways might we connect the two in terms of Latinidad? In light of this course theme, how do Wiliams and Campo write about literature, including their own?
